title: Are Animal Years Comparable? Benchmarking Cross-Species Biological Age Equivalence Across Mammals
domain: comparative biology / geroscience / life-history evolution / computational biology
summary: A multi-axis benchmark of cross-species age-equivalence definitions. Official AnAge Pilot 0 now compares two published life-history coordinates across 785 non-human mammals and shows large species- and stage-dependent disagreement, motivating independent event, demographic and molecular validation.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided run with live literature/novelty audit and public-web fallback for literature stages
